[D9:10] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a trophy with a glass globe on top

[D9:14] Gina: Way to go, Jon! Keep it up, you're almost there!

Session date: 12:48 am on 1 February, 2023
[D3:5] Jon: Wow, it looks great! Must've taken you ages to design it. What made you pick out the furniture and decor?
[D3:6] Gina: Thanks! It took a bit of time but I wanted to make the place look like my own style and make my customers feel cozy. I chose furniture that looks great and is comfy too. The chandelier adds a nice glam feel while matching the style of the store.
[D3:7] Jon: Your store looks great - your customers will be so comfy.
[D3:8] Gina: Thanks! Making my spot comfortable and inviting for my customers is key. I want 'em to feel like they're in a cool oasis. Just creating an experience that'll make 'em wanna come back.
[D3:9] Jon: That's a great goal! Creating a special experience for customers is the key to making them feel welcome and coming back. I think you can create that space you're imagining.
[D3:10] Gina: Thanks. Your support means a lot. I'm sure with my hard work and effort, I can make a special shopping experience for my customers. It's tough but I'm up for the challenge!
[D3:11] Jon: I'm always here to support you! Go create something awesome with your store. Keep it up!
[D3:12] Gina: Thanks, Jon! I'll try my best. You're gonna do great with your dance studio, just keep going and stay positive! We'll get through this!
[D3:13] Jon: Thanks! Your words mean a lot. I'm staying positive and pushing forward. We've put our hearts into our dreams and I'm sure we'll make it.
[D3:14] Gina: Sure thing, Jon! Stay motivated and keep going. Hard work pays off eventually. We can do this!
Session date: 10:43 am on 4 February, 2023
[D4:1] Jon: Hey Gina! What's up? How's the store going? I gotta tell you about this thing with my biz.
[D4:2] Gina: Hey Jon! The store's doing great! It's a wild ride. How's the biz?

[D4:4] Gina: Wow! You've got drive! Keep it up and you'll definitely make a splash.

[D4:7] Jon: Thanks! Setbacks can be tough, but with your support, I can handle anything. Appreciate you having my back!
[D4:8] Gina: I'm here for you no matter what! Anything you want to say about your biz?
[D4:9] Jon: Searching for a dance studio location has been tricky, but I'm determined to find the right spot - when I do, I'm sure the rest will follow!
[D4:10] Gina: Searching for the perfect dance studio's a tough job, Jon. Hang in there and you'll find it soon!
[D4:11] Jon: Thanks! Appreciate your encouragement - it means a lot! I'm working on my business and some new dance routines - rehearsing hard for an upcoming show. I'm passionate about dancing and it brings me so much joy and fulfillment.
[D4:11] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman in a gray dress doing a trick
[D4:12] Gina: Wow, Jon! You're so talented! What show ya got planned?

[D4:14] Gina: Wow Jon, you're gonna kill it in that competition. Your hard work and talent will pay off! Good luck.
[D4:15] Jon: Thanks! Your help means a lot. I'll do my best to make you proud!
[D4:16] Gina: No doubt, Jon you've got this. Your passion and commitment are awesome! Keep it up!
[D4:17] Jon: Thanks! I'm going for my dreams!
[D4:18] Gina: Absolutely Jon. I'm always here to cheer you on. Make your dreams happen - keep going and believe in yourself. You got this!
[D4:19] Jon: Thanks, Gina! Your kind words mean a lot. I won't give up!
Session date: 9:32 am on 8 February, 2023
[D5:1] Gina: Hey Jon! Great hearing from you again. How have you been? BTW, I found a cool new fashion piece for my store. Can't wait to share with my customers.
[D5:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of women posing with a giant balloon
[D5:2] Jon: Hey Gina! Congrats on the new fashion piece! Looks like your store is growing. Remenber the festival I told you about? Had that performance and it was awesome - so many people there complementing my dance moves. Dancing brings me joy and it was nice to be reminded why I'm passionate about it.
[D5:2] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of young girls in a dance studio
[D5:3] Gina: Wow! That looks great. You look badass on stage. BTW, what's your favorite part of running your own studio?
[D5:4] Jon: Thanks, Gina! I love running my own studio. It's great having the freedom to create a space and help dancers of all ages and levels express themselves. I'm super thrilled about dancing each day and seeing my students progress. It's so fulfilling.
[D5:5] Gina: That's awesome! I'm sure you feel great knowing your students are doing so well with dance. It's amazing what it can do for people! Oh, and btw - I've been working hard on my online store and just teamed up with a local artist for some cool designs. Check 'em out!
[D5:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a rack of clothes with a coat and a dress
[D5:6] Jon: It looks awesome. Your commitment and creativity in your business really stands out. How'd you come up with these cool designs?
[D5:7] Gina: Thanks Jon! I got the idea from a fashion mag and saw there wasn't much around like it. So I worked with the artist to make it happen - it's all about being ahead of the game and giving my customers something different.
[D5:8] Jon: Nice one, Gina! You never shy away from a challenge and always try something new. I'm impressed by your willingness to take risks - it's really inspiring.
[D5:9] Gina: Thanks! Taking risks is scary but it's the only way to grow, right? Just part of the journey to success.
[D5:10] Jon: Yeah, I totally agree - taking risks is key for success. It's made me grow, and even got me out of my secure 9-5 as a banker. Now, I'm aiming to turn my dancing passion into a business. I'm determined to make it work, I just know it! That being said, I definitely don't underestimate the difficulties - it ain't been a walk in the park, that's for sure.
[D5:11] Gina: It's tough starting a biz, but don't let it get you down. You can make your studio work, I'm sure. And remember, I'm always here for you.
[D5:12] Jon: Thanks, Gina. Your help means a lot. I'll keep plugging away and stay optimistic.
[D5:12] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a cartoon character with a quote about fear
[D5:13] Gina: This quote kept me positive through tough times. We all need a push sometimes, right? Even made a tattoo to remind myself about it.
[D5:13] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman standing on a balcony with a blue dress
[D5:14] Jon: Love the tattoo, did you just get it?
[D5:15] Gina: Thanks! Got the tattoo a few years ago, it stands for freedom - dancing without worrying what people think. A reminder to follow my passions and express myself.
[D5:16] Jon: Nice reminder, Gina! It's so important to have freedom and express ourselves without worry. Dance gives me an escape to be myself.
[D5:16] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman in a tutu posing for a picture
[D5:17] Gina: Totally agree, Jon. Dancing lets us be ourselves and ain't nothing like the feeling it gives us. You're so dedicated to your studio, it's inspiring. Chase those dreams, buddy!
